note: Arsenal 3-1 Liverpool, Premier League, Emirates Stadium, 4 February 2024, 67th minute (2-1). Chapter 1 is keyed from 'long ball' (the clearance) through 'Gabriel Martinelli' and 'chases it' (the chase), 'keeps pushing' (the shoulder into Van Dijk), 'keeper rushes' and 'and misses' (Alisson's air-kick) to 'rolls it' (the finish). Chapter 2 rings Van Dijk on 'thinks he has time', draws the press on 'presses' and the look to the keeper on 'leaves it'. Chapter 3 sparks the collision on 'crash together'. Every cue starts with a plain word; "defender's" only appears mid-sentence.

chapters.label: The chase, live
chapters.text: Arsenal against Liverpool, 2024. A long ball flies forward. Gabriel Martinelli chases it and keeps pushing. The keeper rushes out, swings... and misses! Martinelli rolls it into the empty net!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Van Dijk thinks he has time. But Martinelli presses him, so Van Dijk leaves it for his keeper.

chapters.label: The pounce
chapters.text: Alisson and Van Dijk crash together. The ball bounces free, and Martinelli pounces!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: chase every loose ball. Pressing can turn a defender's mistake into a goal.
